inlines.v: VICIS'SITUDE, noun [Latin vicissitudo; from vicis, a turn.] 1. Regular change or succession of one thing to another; as the vicissitudes of day and night, and of winter and summer; the vicissitudes of the seasons. 2. Change; revolution; as in human affairs. We are exposed to continual vicissitudes of fortune.
